LanguageData.DMS_Army.label: Colonization Forces
LanguageData.DMS_Army.description: A militarized colonial organization led by an artificial intelligence. Their culture is built heavily on military rank, and anyone who proves their ability can find their place within it through a strict system of accountability.\n\nWhat is certain is that behind this colonial force stands a vast organization capable of coordinating operations across star systems even when interstellar voyages take decades, with large numbers of mechanized troops and heavy weapons to guarantee their peaceful development of this planet and their infrastructure assistance.
